test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

One should never _______ from pals or activities that formerly provided solace.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Withdraw**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "withdraw." 
 
• **Withdraw**: To pull back or retreat; to remove oneself from a situation or activity. (पीछे हटना या पीछे हटना; किसी स्थिति या गतिविधि से स्वयं को दूर करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *After facing a challenging time, it's important not to withdraw from friends or hobbies that used to bring comfort.*
 
 
 
• The word "**withdraw**" fits well in the context of the sentence.
 
• It conveys the idea that, in times of difficulty or distress, it is essential not to isolate oneself from friends (referred to as "**pals**" in the sentence) or activities that were previously a source of comfort ("**solace**").
 
• The **complete sentence** would be: *One should never withdraw __from pals or activities that formerly provided solace.*

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Remove: **To take something away or eliminate it from its current position or context. (किसी चीज़ को उसकी वर्तमान स्थिति या संदर्भ से दूर ले जाना या ख़त्म करना)
 
• **Suspend: **To temporarily stop or interrupt an activity, process, or status. (किसी गतिविधि, प्रक्रिया या स्थिति को अस्थायी रूप से रोकना या बाधित करना)
 
• **Deduct: **To subtract or take away a specific amount or portion from a total. (कुल में से कोई विशिष्ट राशि या भाग घटाना या घटाना)
